text: Are the OLDER, lower leaves turning yellow first?
Are the NEWEST leaves at the top turning yellow, with green veins?
Is the leaf yellow between the veins while the veins themselves stay green?
Are the edges/tips of the leaves turning brown and dry (scorched-looking)?
Do the leaves or stems look purplish or reddish?
Are there small brown or black spots on the leaves, often with a yellow ring around them?
Is there a white or grey powdery coating on the leaves?
Are there dark, water-soaked patches on the leaves that look greasy or wet?
Is there a black, sooty coating on the leaves that wipes off?
Do the leaves feel sticky, or is there a shiny residue on them?
Are there holes or chewed edges in the leaves?
Are the leaves curling, twisting, or cupping upward/downward?
Is the plant wilting, and does the soil around it feel dry?
Is the plant wilting even though the soil is moist or waterlogged?
Is the plant noticeably smaller or slower-growing than nearby plants of the same age?
Can you see insects (tiny bugs, caterpillars, or flying pests) on the plant?
Is there fine webbing on the underside of leaves?
Has there been heavy rain or standing water in the field in the last few days?
Has it been more than a week since the field was last watered or rained on?
Did these symptoms appear and spread within the last 2-3 days?
